# source: libertine package README (CTAN): Linux Libertine as the roman
# family, Linux Biolinum as the sans family and Linux Libertine Mono as the
# typewriter family (libertine.sty's \setmonofont, on by default). The
# font-switching commands it defines stay refused by name.
pre impl \usepackage{libertine}
body refuse:W0301 \libertine{}
body refuse:W0301 \biolinum{}
